name: WiFi (WCN3990 through the modem) - EXPERIMENTAL
description: Boots the modem (it runs the WLAN firmware), the kernel sends it the board data file (bdwlan) like Android's cnss-daemon did, and the qcacld host driver creates wlan0, which HarmonyOS's WiFi HDI uses directly. The MAC address comes from the persist partition. EXPERIMENTAL: keep 'Remove setup wizard' on until WiFi is confirmed working.
